comment: Reviewed false positives of tools/check-emulator-terms.py (C-SEP-TERMS): words that also occur in vendor/emulator/ but carry no emulator internals where they are used. Listed by the SHA-256 prefix the check prints, with a reason that doesn't name the word. Added only by pull request. Terms that occur in docs/HARDWARE-SPEC.md or docs/HARNESS.md on main need no entry (the check accepts them); entries they covered were dropped on 2026-10-22 (session M0e-spec).

reviewed.reason: The largest raw image's length (1 MiB less 16 KiB) written in hex, from docs/HARDWARE-SPEC.md (HW-5) and docs/HARNESS.md ('The raw image'), used as the image region's length in the firmware's linker script.

Part of public GitHub repository names in audit/targets.json (the name of another M-VAVE keyboard, which some FM-1 firmwares are ported to), written there by tools/audit-discover.py from repository metadata; not taken from the emulator.
